Allergen practice

Egg and sweet potato

Tojás édesburgonyával

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 1 portion

From 6 months, with the egg fully cooked. Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. Once egg is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 egg (hard-boiled until the yolk is firm)
  • 100 g sweet potato (cooked and mashed)

Allergens

egg

Method

  1. Boil the egg for 10 minutes and cool it in cold water.
  2. Cook the sweet potato until soft, then mash the flesh.
  3. Peel the egg and mash it into the sweet potato.
  4. Thin with a little water if the purée is stiff.
  5. Mash out any lump of egg white before serving.

Sound idea

A soft yolk is not fully cooked.

Mash a hard-boiled egg into sweet-potato purée.
